messages.author: 6f05886448e0b381
messages.subject: shinyapps not available for 3.2.0
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've tried installing shinyapps, but get the following error:

"Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘shinyapps’ is not available (for R version 3.2.0)"

Just curious: when will shinyapps become available for 3.2.0, "Full of Ingredients"? Thanks!

David

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps not available for 3.2.0
parts:
Hi,

shinyapps is not available on CRAN. You should install it from github:

For example:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

Cheers
-Andy
